title: Armenian text assignment is not included in the saved fields
reasoning: The fetcher assigns the scraped text to reading.text_hy, but the subsequent save(update_fields=...) does not include text_hy. If text_hy is a normal model field, Django will persist only i18n, text_hy_version, and text_hy_fetched_at, leaving the fetched Armenian text unsaved while returning True. The confidence is medium because the excerpt does not show the Reading model; if text_hy is a property that writes through i18n, this may be intentional, but the field map later treats text_hy as the response field.
recommendation: Include the actual stored Armenian text field in update_fields, or if text_hy intentionally writes through i18n, make that contract explicit and ensure the assigned value is persisted by the named field.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No tests were included for this feature, and there is no evidence of a regression test that reloads a Reading from the database after fetch_armenian_text returns True.
suggestedRegressionTest: Create a Reading with a matching Armenian scraped entry, call fetch_armenian_text, reload the Reading from the database, and assert that text_hy contains the scraped text along with the version and fetched timestamp.
